# ImageDecodeError

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Thrown when image bytes cannot be decoded: the compressed pixel data is corrupt or truncated, or the image is larger than [`ImageLoader.maxPixels`](image-loader.md#maxpixels). Images often come from end users, so catch this where an upload is turned into a document.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `BonniePdfError`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ImageDecodeError(message: string, options?: { cause?: unknown; })
```
